subject: reasoning
question:
This question is based on the five, three-digit numbers given below.

(Left) 773 263 387 270 378 (Right)

(Example: 697 – First digit = 6, second digit = 9 and third digit = 7) (NOTE: All operations to be done from left to right.) What will be the resultant if the first digit of the lowest number is subtracted from the first digit of the highest number?
solution:
The logic follows here is :-

Given numbers: 773 263 387 270 378

The lowest number is **263**.

Now, extract the first digit of the lowest number:

 
• First digit of 263 is 2.

The highest number is **773**.</p&g
